acceptance: Assert steps read result_path from the sweep's cells.jsonl and check benchmark.platform and scale_factor inside the JSON
Stream-count and metric checks count throughput rows only and exclude failed queries
Unreadable result JSON fails the cell
Stale docs, comments and the dead-path test are updated or removed
context: 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1). Stream-count over-counting is latent with current configs.
description:
The result-path manifest is only partly used:
- resolve_official_result_path discards its platform and scale arguments (tests/uat/throughput.py:71), and runner.py:300 accepts any existing .json without a token check.
- Both nightly assert steps still use glob plus mtime (nightly.yml:1068-1074, 1134-1140). The Postgres pattern tpch_sf1_postgres* is not an exact token.

validate_stream_count counts distinct stream values across all query rows (throughput.py:116-120). Power warm-up and measurement rows also carry stream numbers (execution.py:225,237), so adding power to a config could let 2 real throughput streams plus power rows pass a 3-stream check. validate_throughput_metric counts failed queries in total_queries, and only recomputes from the same JSON with a 2x band, so it catches formula bugs only.

runner.py:459-460: a "could not read result JSON" error leaves a passed cell as passed. Currently masked by an earlier check.

Stale: docs/operations/uat-framework.md:608 says both cells gate. throughput.py:3-12 and matrix.py:502-504 describe the unused _forward_requested_streams patch, and tests/integration/test_throughput_stream_count.py:240-291 still tests it.
